decisions.reason: The current 66,699-row corpus reproduces the deployed 64,218 trainable samples exactly and has no duplicate/conflicting fixture keys or direct outcome columns in the feature list.
decisions.next_action: Keep as the frozen benchmark; do not overwrite it while expanding data.

decisions.reason: Retraining the same unchanged corpus would not address the identified coverage or provenance gaps.
decisions.next_action: Do not spend compute retraining the same 64,218 samples.

decisions.reason: The current ensemble depends on bookmaker-price features. The expanded competitions do not yet have verified odds-backed history, and the legacy corpus cannot prove row-level price timing/source.
decisions.next_action: Build an odds-backed market_training dataset with explicit source/snapshot provenance before any expanded retrain.

decisions.reason: Verified free results-history sources exist for 6 of 9 currently missing live competitions. They can improve football history without pretending bookmaker odds exist.
decisions.next_action: Ingest the verified results-only sources into a separate football_history dataset and keep unresolved competitions fail-closed.

decisions.reason: A football-first challenger can use verified results/form/ELO history without requiring bookmaker odds, but the new sources have not yet been ingested and validated.
decisions.next_action: After results-only ingestion, train an isolated challenger with league-aware chronological evaluation; never overwrite production models.
